The '''Hovan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Hovan 99]].<ref name="ITGU">{{Tales|19|Into the Great Unknown}}</ref>

The system's asteroids were subject to rivalry and conflict between sanctioned and renegade mining teams, as well as frigates belonging to [[House Garonnin]]. The asteroids were a last refuge for those wanted by the authorities of the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex]] and [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex]] sectors.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
